criteria.fine: The change addresses the failure and does not loosen any check.
criteria.unrelated: The change is mostly in files unrelated to the failure, or outside its module.
criteria.weakens: The change loosens a test, assertion, rule or threshold instead of fixing the code.

triage_complexity.question: How big is this ticket to implement?

criteria.S: One or two small acceptance criteria in one module.
criteria.M: Several criteria, or more than one ecosystem.
criteria.L: Many criteria or a wide change across modules.

triage_risk.question: How risky is this ticket to change?

criteria.low: One known module and no sensitive path.
criteria.medium: No known module, or an unclear scope.
criteria.high: A risk or security label, a sensitive path, or more than one module.

cause.question: Why did the step keep failing?

criteria.impl_bug: The code is wrong; the spec is fine.
criteria.spec_gap: The spec leaves out something the step needs.
criteria.spec_conflict: Two parts of the spec contradict each other.
criteria.flaky: The failure looks unrelated to the change and may pass on a rerun.

merge_risk.question: How risky is it to merge this change, 0 (none) to 10 (very)?
